name: io.github.yasmanycastillo/model-shunt
description: Model routing for AI coding agents: delegate bulk file reading and boilerplate code generation to fast, economical worker models (Gemini Flash, Groq, Ollama, DeepSeek). Cuts primary agent token consumption by up to 90% via three tools: bulk_read, code_write, and get_available_models. Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies.

environmentVariables.name: SHUNT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Worker provider: gemini, openai, groq, deepseek, anthropic, openrouter, or ollama

environmentVariables.name: SHUNT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Worker model override, or 'auto' to pick the best model per task

environmentVariables.name: SHUNT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the worker provider (provider-specific keys like GEMINI_API_KEY also work)

environmentVariables.name: SHUNT_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: PATH-style list of directories bulk_read/code_write may touch (defaults to the workspace)
